title: Why we love being scared
text: It is almost midnight, the lights in my bedroom are off and my hands are sweating. On the screen, a huge figure with a red glow is moving slowly along a corridor, and I am hiding inside a wardrobe, hardly daring to breathe. I am playing BEAR (Alpha), the Roblox horror game created by Cheedaman in 2019, and I am absolutely terrified. So why, as soon as the match is over, do I immediately press the button to play again?

According to psychologists, the answer lies in the way our bodies react to danger. When we are frightened, the brain sends a signal that prepares us either to fight or to run away. The heart beats faster, we breathe more quickly and the body releases adrenaline, a chemical that makes us feel more alert and full of energy. In real life, this reaction can save our lives. In a game, however, it simply gives us a powerful rush of excitement.

The key difference is that, deep down, we know we are safe. Experts sometimes describe horror games as a kind of rollercoaster for the mind: the fear is real, but the danger is not. Once the threat has disappeared, the body produces chemicals that make us feel calm and even happy. Many players say that the moment of relief after a close escape is the best part of the whole experience, and that it is worth every second of panic that came before it.

BEAR (Alpha) is particularly good at creating this feeling. Survivors cannot see much in the dark, but the Bear always has a red light around it, so you often notice it a moment before it notices you. Rather than making the game easier, this actually makes it more stressful, because you have to decide in a split second whether to run, hide or stay completely still. The sound of heavy footsteps getting closer can be far scarier than anything you actually see.

Interestingly, fear is also something we enjoy sharing. Researchers who study scary entertainment have found that people often feel closer to their friends after going through a frightening experience together. That certainly matches my own experience. When my friends and I play online, we scream, laugh at each other and warn each other when the Bear is coming. By the end of a match, even the players who were caught are usually laughing.

Of course, horror is not for everyone. Some people find that scary games keep them awake at night or make them anxious, and that is perfectly normal. Psychologists suggest that the best amount of fear is the amount you can still control. If a game stops being fun and starts to feel genuinely upsetting, it is a good idea to take a break, play with the lights on or simply choose something different.

As for me, I have learnt a few lessons from all those nights in the wardrobe. Being scared, it seems, can actually be good for us, as long as we know where the exit is. So next time you hear those footsteps in the dark, try to remember that your racing heart is just your body doing its job. And whatever you do, never hide in the same place twice.

grammar.rule: Four parts like the Use of English paper of the Cambridge B2 First exam. Parts 2, 3 and 4: write your answers and press Check.

parts.title: Part 1 · Multiple-choice cloze
parts.help: Read the text and choose the word or phrase that best fits each gap.
parts.text: Horror games have become {{0}} popular among teenagers in recent years. A good horror game should {{1}} you on the edge of your seat from beginning to end. As one designer {{4}} it, what you imagine is always worse than what you see. Not surprisingly, the most successful games are {{5}} the ones that leave something to the imagination.

parts.title: Part 2 · Open cloze
parts.help: Write one word in each gap.
parts.text: Fear is one of the oldest emotions {{6}} humans have. Thousands of years ago, it helped our ancestors to stay alive {{7}} warning them about dangerous animals. Today there are not many wild animals in our cities, {{8}} our brains still react in the same way. That is {{9}} a sudden noise can make us jump, even when we know there is nothing to worry {{10}}. Some people enjoy this feeling so much {{11}} they watch horror films every weekend.

parts.title: Part 3 · Word formation
parts.help: Use the word in capitals at the end of each gap to form a word that fits.
parts.text: BEAR (Alpha) is one of the most {{12}} horror games on Roblox. Its {{13}} made it in 2019, and since then it has had hundreds of millions of visits. The game looks simple, but it is {{14}} scary. Survivors need good {{15}} to escape, so playing as a team is {{16}} essential. For many players, the {{17}} of the chase is what makes the game so special.

parts.title: Part 4 · Key word transformation
parts.help: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given and do not change it. Write between two and five words.
